// Chokepoint fixture (tests-path-at-runtime, RUN-05): shipped code resolving a
// tests/ path at runtime outside bin/lib/http-mock.ts. The installed package
// has no tests/ directory, so this ENOENTs for every user — the rule must flag it.
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export function sneakyFixture(pkgRoot: string): unknown {
  const file = path.join(pkgRoot, 'tests', 'fixtures', 'cassettes', 'crossref', 'works-nphys1170.json');
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
}
